plain: Hasty and rash, acting on sudden impulse

webster.text: Rushing with great force and violence; moving rapidly; furious; forcible; fierce; raging; as an impetuous wind; an impetuous torrent.

more.text: Vehement of mind; fierce; hasty; passionate; violent; as a man of impetuous temper.

example.quote: A necessary fence agst. this danger would be to select a portion of enlightened citizens, whose limited number, and firmness might seasonably interpose agst. impetuous councils.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, June 26, 1787
